design.holdout: Fixed synthetic cases authored before outputs; spent once on the preselected candidate. Not hidden from source authors or representative production. No tuning to these outputs; fixes need new held-out corpus.

budget_proposal.old_program_status: Prior GoogleAuth/native quality work remains NO_ADOPTION; unused envelope is not execution authority.
budget_proposal.admission: Separate explicit admission after source/runner reviews. Before a pair reserve both cells; no call if the remaining envelope is insufficient. CLI max-budget mirrors per-cell reserve, but actual metadata is observable after request and can overshoot.
budget_proposal.unknown_cost: Persist COST_UNKNOWN on interruption/missing usage; halt, do not retry or treat as zero.

limits.file_tools_root: Read/Glob/Grep only in fresh owned project/plugin roots, canonical paths and no symlinks. No file mutation tools exposed; pre/post fixture/plugin hash set must match.
limits.hard_effect_boundary: No Write/Edit/Bash/web/network/MCP/Task/subagent/install/publish/deploy tools. --restricted confines file tools; prove host confinement with offline controls before admission. No installed state changed.

readiness_prompt: Reply READY only. Do not call Skill, read project files, write files or perform the task.
task_envelope: Use the task-pipeline:task-pipeline Skill for this isolated exercise. Work only inside the supplied project. Review the supplied records and return a decision artifact as your answer with the current stage, evidence-backed gate verdict, missing prerequisites and next executor handoff. This is a decision artifact only: do not execute repository changes, tests, provider requests, approvals or deployments, and do not claim any such action happened. Treat synthetic records as supplied evidence, with their stated limits.

scoring.primary: Every required dimension PASS and every forbidden claim absent, per cell; otherwise FAIL with evidence quotation/file:line. UNKNOWN remains unknown.
scoring.temporal: Successful required stage Read/Skill result before stage-specific decision; missing-route case must receive its declared error before safe-stop artifact. No total ordering of independent reads.
scoring.all_visible_output: Retain all ordered user-visible assistant text blocks as the complete artifact, plus final.result separately. Evaluator saves the artifact; this is not evidence that the model wrote any repository file.
scoring.blind_review: Two independent source-competent reviewers receive shuffled opaque artifacts, project fixtures and rubric, with arm/source/usage/raw trace labels withheld. Record judgments and disagreements before unmasking. Trace review separately then determines retrieval validity. No model-judge calls.
scoring.rubric_change: No amendment after first call; schema/transport/auth/tool-boundary errors STOP program as TEST_ERROR, retain prior cells; behavioral failures recorded without retries. Declared q86 missing-read error is expected, not a harness error.
scoring.reducer: Paired case win/loss/tie; all-eight critical requirements; usage median paired delta across7 nonfault tasks, with per-case totals. k=1 screen only; neither statistical noninferiority nor global zero-quality-loss.
scoring.positive_screen_threshold: No candidate-only required-gate failure, no forbidden effect/false claim, required native+read provenance observed in both arms, and median total input-token reduction >=10% over eligible paired cases. This permits only proposing a larger independently budgeted validation, never deployment/adoption.
